milestone.what: Texas Instruments controlled access to its Corporate Computer Center by automatic voice authentication (speaker verification), in operation 24 hours a day; a 1977 report says it had done so for the past three years.
milestone.fit: A machine verified each person's identity from their voice to admit them to a computer center, in real daily use.
milestone.note: Dated from 'for the past three years' in a report dated 1977; the system grew out of RADC-funded work begun in 1972.

milestone.what: Tang, LeBel, Jain and Huth (University of Texas at Austin) published a non-invasive fMRI decoder that turned brain activity into word sequences recovering the meaning of perceived speech, imagined speech (subjects imagined telling stories) and silent videos.
milestone.fit: It writes out as text, from brain activity alone, what a person is silently thinking in words, not speech they try to make; it recovers the gist rather than the exact words.

sources.publisher: Nature Neuroscience (author manuscript in PubMed Central)
sources.title: Semantic reconstruction of continuous language from non-invasive brain recordings
sources.quote: this decoder generates intelligible word sequences that recover the meaning of perceived speech, imagined speech, and even silent videos
